title: Challenges Faced by Employers in Implementing Enhanced Childcare Leave, Tracking Usage of the Leave and Accreditation for Work-life Friendly Workplaces
what_it_is: Challenges Faced by Employers in Implementing Enhanced Childcare Leave, Tracking Usage of the Leave and Accreditation for Work-life Friendly Workplaces

sections.label: Enhanced child-related leave and support
sections.summary: The Government will enhance child-related leave, financial support, caregiving and housing measures to give Singaporeans confidence in starting and raising families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As announced by the Prime Minister at the National Day Rally, the Government will enhance child-related leave, financial support, caregiving and housing measures to provide greater confidence and assurance to Singaporeans in starting and raising families.

sections.label: Employer reimbursement for child-related leave
sections.summary: Employers need time to manage operational impact of Childcare Leave enhancements, with details by early next year, and Government will reimburse employers for all child-related leave up to a cap.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We also need to give employers time to manage the operational impact of the Childcare Leave enhancements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We will share more details by early next year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As announced, the Government will reimburse employers for the full duration of all child-related leave, up to a cap.

sections.label: Childcare Leave take-up and Workgroup
sections.summary: Childcare Leave take-up rates are tracked from employer claims and published annually in MSF's Family Trends Report, and the Workgroup will share recommendations in early 2027.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Specific to Childcare Leave, we track Childcare Leave take-up rates among parents, which are based on employer claims, and publish them annually in the Ministry of Social and Family Development's (MSF's) Family Trends Report.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Workgroup will share its full set of recommendations in early 2027.

sections.label: Government paying parental leave, backfilling planning
sections.summary: Government will pay for all parental related leave to alleviate employers' financial burden, and tripartite partners must work on sustainable backfilling with companies planning for gaps.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Step one is that the Government now says that it will provide or it will pay for all parental related leave.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Another, maybe to get people from outside to backfill, but in order to do that, you need advanced planning and working arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, step one is really to alleviate the financial burden on the employers, but I think in the longer term, we also need to work with the tripartite partners on how you can have sustainable backfilling.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Companies should be planning on the assumption that there will, at any given time, be a gap – whether it is one for which advanced notice can be given, like Shared Parental Leave because you know in advance, or things like Childcare Leave where you do not know when your child is going to be sick and you may need to take leave at very short notice.

sections.label: Divide between parents and non-parents
sections.summary: The enhancements are supported but may cause an unintended workplace divide between parents and non-parents, especially non-parents with frontline or senior caregiving duties who cover duties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
sentences.text: I support the enhancements in the latest childcare support policies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang West)
sentences.text: However, it may cause an unintended divide between parents and non-parents at the workplace, especially for non-parents who are frontline workers or have heavy caregiving duties for senior parents who would have to step up, cover duties.

sections.label: Sector-by-sector tripartite approach
sections.summary: The approach will be sector by sector, getting trade associations and chambers on board and working through the tripartite model.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: What we intend to do is to approach it sector by sector, get the trade associations and chambers on board, and work on it using the tripartite model.

sections.label: Encashing leave suggestion
sections.summary: The Member suggested encashing the leave, but encashing leave does not take care of the need for time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Member had suggested maybe having them encash the leave.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Encashing the leave does not take care of the need for time.

sections.label: Sick child care need
sections.summary: If a child is suddenly ill, the child will not go to infant, childcare or student care, and money from encashing leave will not help.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But if the child is suddenly taken ill, the child is not going to be going to infant care, childcare or student care.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And no amount of money given to the parent to encash the leave is going to help the child who is at home without somebody to look after them.

sections.label: Accreditation study
sections.summary: On accreditation, the speaker says they will study it and are actively looking at it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For the first one, on the accreditation, we will study that, so we are actively looking at that.

sections.label: Sick bays in childcare
sections.summary: On sick bays in childcare centres, the speaker will ask Senior Minister of State Goh Pei Ming to look into this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: On the second one, the suggestion for sick bays in childcare centres, I will certainly ask Senior Minister of State Goh Pei Ming, who is at the Ministry of Social and Family Development, to look into this.
